structural_verification.change: After the adjacent same-block i64 unsigned division/remainder fusion on x86_64, call Context::verify(isa) unconditionally instead of verify_if(isa) gated by enable_verifier. Fail compiler compilation on structural-verifier errors.
structural_verification.checked_properties: Cranelift verification of existing/defined SSA values, dominance, result arity, type constraints, block integrity, CFG and dominator consistency; not semantic equivalence of machine code or target states.

exhaustive_scaled_model.domain: All 256x256 unsigned 8-bit x/y inputs of a width-scaled two-live-pair WAT semantics; bit-serial quotient/remainder candidate vs independent Python // and % reference
exhaustive_scaled_model.local: Python 3.13 local exhaustive execution and four negative mutation controls passed

existing_x64_cost_evidence: Prior source-pinned identical-WAT two-live-pair native instruction bytes 97->73, divisions 4->2, whole-AOT 13608->13608; not re-proved here as novel or faster.
limits: 8-bit exhaustiveness cannot prove arbitrary unsigned 64-bit semantics or whole x86 lowering.

Unconditional Cranelift structural verification detects malformed CLIF/SSA/CFG; it does not prove transformation semantics, flags, undefined state, poison, all native trap-table/PC mappings or general compiler-pass soundness.
